note: Trace form (research/trace-harness.md) for L11: the static twins, served by scripts/trace.sh, from trace/overlay/trace-entry.js, which makes the work behind each lazily built value its real size (a 600,000-line postcode file; a PDF module that builds its tables when it loads, replacing the twin's tiny stand-in; 50,000 countries in the seed) and then imports the twin's src/app.js unchanged. For each request, the twin is started three times, and each time the first request is timed against the five after it. A first request at least 20 ms and three times slower than the median of the later ones, in every start, waits for set-up (STB-10). A timing: it counts only under the timing lock (the three first-request times), and is otherwise info (timing unreliable). defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other request is a decoy, in both twins.
